To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) Big data analytics is a hot topic in many areas of application, including healthcare, social networks, finance and business intelligence, (b) real-time processing of Big Data is an emerging area of research, (c) the main challenges in real-time processing of large data are the scalability, reliability, and performance, (d) the main technologies used are MapReduce and stream processing, (e) there are many open issues in this area, such as data integration, data quality,
the majority of real-time applications are using Hadoop, Storm and Kafka, and Spark, and the most used programming language is Java.

1) the main reason for choosing a technology in a field of application is the availability of the technology; 2) in the field of application where the data are generated in real-time, the technology used is the one that is available; and 3) the technology that has been used the most in all the fields of application is the one that has been used in the field of the Internet of Things.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following: (a) What are the different fields of application of real-time analytics of big data?
the following questions: (a) What are the applications and use cases for real-time Big Data analytics?
the analysis of the state-of-the-art in real-time analytics and its application in different fields of interest.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single technology that can solve the real-time analytics problem.
there is no one-size-fits-all solution to the problem of real-time analytics.
real-time analytics is an emerging field with a great potential for the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
real-time analytics is a complex process, where the data is collected and analyzed in real-time.
the most common technologies used in Big Data analytics are Apache Hadoop and Apache Spark.
real-time analytics has been applied to a number of domains and that there is a wide variety of technologies and techniques being used in these domains.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of the technology is highly application dependent and depends on the nature of the data.
the most important factor is not the volume or velocity of data but the nature of the data and the type of analytics needed.
the field of Big Data analytics is still in its early stages, with a lot of room for further research and development.
